nodes.label: HACS zip_release content_in_root Convention
nodes.rationale: HACS's zip_release download mode with content_in_root:false extracts the release archive straight into the plugin's own folder, so the zip's contents must sit at the top level (built from inside public/) rather than under a public/ wrapper directory.

nodes.label: Live Dashboard README
nodes.rationale: Hand-written single-page Home Assistant dashboard for a wall-mounted tablet; discovers rooms/entities from HA registries instead of Lovelace cards or YAML.

nodes.label: Live Dashboard README (Italian)
nodes.rationale: Italian translation of README.md; notes TROUBLESHOOTING.md is English-only.

nodes.label: panel_custom panel
nodes.rationale: Only supported install method; camera snapshot/stream URLs are HA-signed and same-origin with the panel, which a standalone/token variant would have to handle differently.

nodes.label: Wall tablet landscape-first design
nodes.rationale: Fixed ~1200x800 landscape target is deliberate; columns size tiles to content and scroll internally rather than stretching.

nodes.label: Mobile layout (dash_neumo_mobile.html)
nodes.rationale: Complete second layout for phones but secondary to the wall tablet.

nodes.label: Demo mode (?demo)
nodes.rationale: Works from file:// with no HA; falls back to demo backend automatically after a timeout, shows a DEMO badge, never calls a real service.

nodes.label: Registry-based auto-discovery
nodes.rationale: With no config, shows up to 12 areas as rooms plus person/weather/alarm entities; result is only as good as the user's area assignments. House-mode, Energy, Irrigation, Vehicle stay off by default rather than guessing wrong.

nodes.label: Alarm panel auto-discovery via supported_features
nodes.rationale: v1.5.4: first alarm_control_panel of any brand; arm buttons follow supported_features so no button is shown that would fail.

nodes.label: Room domains and sensor pills
nodes.rationale: Rooms show what you would act on or ask about; binary_sensor pills only while on, battery only under 20%, power-metering sensors never shown as pills.

nodes.label: No build step, plain ES modules
nodes.norm_label: no build step, plain es modules

nodes.label: Vendored React 18.3.1 runtime (public/vendor)
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: ships React locally instead of a CDN so a local-only HA still draws the dashboard; Diagnostica shows which React copy ran. Google Fonts fall back to system font offline.

nodes.label: HACS installation
nodes.rationale: Recommended: update notifications; installs to config/www/community/live_dashboard/, which is overwritten on every update.

nodes.label: Manual installation
nodes.rationale: Copy public/ into config/www/<folder>/; allows side-by-side copies (casa/casa2), a pattern that does not apply to HACS.

nodes.label: Folder-derived panel tag (<folder>-panel)
nodes.rationale: Panel element registers as <folder>-panel; under HACS always live_dashboard-panel. A mismatch gives a blank panel, now explained via console.error and an on-page message.

nodes.label: module_url ?v= cache busting
nodes.rationale: /local/ is served with long cache headers and browsers cache ES modules aggressively, so the version query must be bumped on each update.

nodes.label: config/www/live_dashboard_config.js
nodes.rationale: User config lives outside the HACS-managed folder so updates never erase it; holds entity IDs so stays out of version control.

nodes.label: Config file lookup order
nodes.rationale: First found wins: config/www/live_dashboard_config.js, then community/live_dashboard/config.js, then config.js next to panel.js (back-compat).

nodes.label: Settings panel (gear, per-user storage)
nodes.rationale: v1.5.0: hides/shows/reorders what auto-discovery found, saved per user in HA account storage so devices stay in sync; config.js still alone resolves sensor roles, the panel only decides visibility. Does not compose layouts from scratch.

nodes.label: Home section order (sections.order)
nodes.rationale: v1.7.0: one order shared by desktop column 3 and mobile Casa stack so tablet and phone never disagree; only reorders Alarm/Energy/Surveillance cards.

nodes.label: HA Energy dashboard mapping
nodes.rationale: Reads HA's own Energy dashboard config automatically; otherwise guesses from device_class energy + total_increasing sensors by name; config.js only overrides.

nodes.label: Energy sensor roles
nodes.rationale: Sensors requested by role (production, consumption, gridImport, gridExport, productionToday, gridToday, gridExportToday, consumptionToday, battery, inverterStatus), not by brand; mapped for FusionSolar, SolarEdge, Fronius, Shelly EM.

nodes.label: Derived house consumption
nodes.rationale: consumption = production + gridImport - gridExport + batteryDischarge - batteryCharge; explicit sensor wins; any missing input gives honest '—'; labeled 'calculated' so never mistaken for a measured sensor.

nodes.label: Battery power sign toggle
nodes.rationale: No universal sign convention; default positive = charging; persistent negative derived consumption raises a warning with one-tap fix.

nodes.label: Instantaneous power unit normalization
nodes.rationale: Normalizes W/kW/MW from unit_of_measurement so mixed integrations are not off by 1000x; Auto/W/kW display; daily totals stay kWh.

nodes.label: Fotovoltaico double ring
nodes.rationale: Outer ring = consumption (autoconsumo + prelievo), inner = production (autoconsumo + immissione); replaces old ring that compared production vs grid import, which summed to nothing real.

nodes.label: Autoconsumo (self-consumption)
nodes.rationale: Shared by both rings, same color; derived as production - gridExport, or consumption - gridImport when consumptionToday is set (preferred, no lockstep assumption).

nodes.label: Single-ring fallback
nodes.rationale: Without an export sensor, falls back to the old single ring rather than a wrong or empty double ring.

nodes.label: Irrigation view
nodes.rationale: Zone needs only moisture plus valve or buttons; agronomic math (ET0/ETc, deficit) is out of scope and left to user automations.

nodes.label: Valve timed close deadline
nodes.rationale: Deadline saved to frontend/user_data (or localStorage), checked every 15s by any open client; requires at least one open dashboard, otherwise use buttons or native valve timer.

nodes.label: Irrigation input_button durations
nodes.rationale: For setups where a script/automation owns timing; takes over from valve if both set.

nodes.label: Weather station (config.weatherStation)
nodes.rationale: Local station preferred over forecast provider; reuses irrigation.weather sensors automatically, only feelsLike/dewPoint need adding.

nodes.label: Vehicle (config.vehicle)
nodes.rationale: No HA domain standardizes car telemetry, so explicit field-by-field mapping; used with Mercedes mbapi2020.

nodes.label: Appliances (config.appliances)
nodes.rationale: Running state from status entity with stateLabels/idleStates; room resolved from status entity area; powerSwitch on is not treated as running and is removed from auto-discovered toggles.

nodes.label: Smart plug three-level state
nodes.rationale: v1.5.4: switch with a device_class power sensor reads off/active/running; threshold 3 W adjustable in Settings → Energia.

nodes.label: Camera auto-discovery
nodes.rationale: Every camera.* auto-discovered with area and motion sensor from same device; previews are entity_picture snapshots every snapshotInterval, paused when page hidden.

nodes.label: Layered camera live view (HLS, hls.js, still polling)
nodes.rationale: v1.5.4: native HLS, then vendored hls.js (not shipped, inactive), then 2-3 fps still polling that works on any camera/platform; Diagnostics shows active layer; detail closes after 2 minutes.
nodes.norm_label: layered camera live view (hls, hls.js, still polling)

nodes.label: Surveillance tab (2+ cameras)
nodes.rationale: With one camera the Casa card is the whole feature; above gridTab (6) grid goes 2→3 columns.

nodes.label: Kiosk mode for the wall tablet
nodes.rationale: Fully Kiosk Browser plus HACS kiosk-mode; 1280x800 landscape target, smaller switches Casa to scrolling layout.
nodes.norm_label: kiosk mode for the wall tablet

nodes.label: Lovelace (not replaced)
nodes.rationale: No card picker, drag-and-drop, or YAML config; Lovelace is the right tool for composing layouts.

nodes.label: Settings → Diagnostica
nodes.rationale: Shows loaded config path, energy sensor resolution and why, without the browser console; Copy diagnostics button for issue reports.

nodes.label: window.CASA_REACT_SOURCE
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: React is vendored (./vendor/react-18.3.1*.js loaded before support.js) instead of fetched from unpkg each load; support.js loadReactUmd() skips its CDN fetch when window.React/ReactDOM exist. CASA_REACT_SOURCE records 'local' vs 'cdn' so Diagnostica > Ambiente can show which runtime actually ran. Versioned file names instead of ?v= because react@18.3.1 content never changes.

nodes.label: DEFAULT_CONFIG
nodes.rationale: Mirrors live_dashboard_config.example.js; a missing/broken config.js degrades to this, never to a crash.

nodes.label: ASSET_V / bust()
nodes.rationale: Reuses panel.js VERSION (?v=) so one bump cache-busts the whole script chain loaded by this file, not just the iframe.

nodes.label: loadScript()
nodes.rationale: Classic <script> injection instead of import(): Chrome blocks ES module fetches from file:// (demo mode); a 404 resolves false, not an error.

nodes.label: switchScenario()
nodes.rationale: Demo scenario bar writes ?scenario= and does a full reload; demo backend has no state worth preserving.

nodes.label: CONFIG_PATHS
nodes.rationale: /local/live_dashboard_config.js (outside HACS-managed folder) first so updates don't wipe config; /local/ candidates skipped outside an iframe to avoid guaranteed console 404s.

nodes.label: loadUserConfig()
nodes.rationale: Records each attempt as plain data (loadScript/defined) for the Diagnostica panel (v1.5.1); defined:false with loadScript:true = file served but syntax error.

nodes.label: _camStartStream()
nodes.rationale: Layered fallback: WS camera stream URL -> native HLS (Safari/iOS) -> hls.js lazily loaded from vendor -> snapshot fast-poll (400ms). camStreamReqId guards against stale async results; diag recorded per camera for Diagnostica.

nodes.label: _attachHlsJs()
nodes.rationale: Used as a ref callback after mount: dynamic src cannot be a template hole (templating constraint #2).

nodes.label: _boot()
nodes.rationale: Loads discovery/prefs/i18n/backends via plain script tags, then config, connects backend, fetches registries, resolves language and energy, loads prefs, then history/hourly energy/irrigation ends.

nodes.label: _resolveEnergyDaily()
nodes.rationale: Daily energy resolution order: config.js -> HA energy/get_prefs (mapEnergyPrefs) -> device_class auto-discovery; result captured as diag data (sources, ids, values, prefsFailed) for Diagnostica.

nodes.label: deriveConsumption()
nodes.rationale: Consumption = production + import - export + battery term, using charge/discharge sensors or a single signed power sensor with user-selected sign convention.

nodes.label: batterySignVerdict()
nodes.rationale: Flags a likely wrong battery sign setting when >50% of >=5 samples over 3 min give negative derived consumption.

nodes.label: call()
nodes.rationale: Every service call is logged to _actionLog (last 20, outcome ok/error/timeout, ms) for Diagnostica 'Ultime azioni' (v1.8.1); failures also raise a visible toast because tablet/companion users have no console.

nodes.label: _checkIrrigationEnds()
nodes.rationale: Irrigation end times are persisted (CasaPrefs.saveIrrigationEnds) so a reload/other device still closes the valve; state is read from the valve itself; _irrigationClosing set prevents double turn_off.

nodes.label: _bindAttr()
nodes.rationale: Ref-callback helper that sets src/href after mount, because the browser's HTML parser loads dynamic src/href before JS runs (templating constraint #2).

nodes.label: SAVE_PREFS()
nodes.rationale: Optimistic setState, then persists via CasaPrefs.save; storage outcome (local vs hass) shown in settings.

nodes.label: diagEnvironment()
nodes.rationale: Diagnostica > Ambiente data: version, backend kind, iframe flags, language, registry counts, rooms/cameras, prefs outcome, reactSource.

nodes.label: renderVals()
nodes.rationale: Builds every template value; negated branches are exposed with distinct names (e.g. noDiagActionRows) rather than repeating the same sc-if expression with opposite placeholders (templating constraint #6).

nodes.label: Hourly energy strip (hourlyBars)
nodes.rationale: v1.8.0: 24 stacked bars per hour (self-consumption --sage, grid --acc, feed-in --feed), same colour grammar as the ring; peak solar hour labelled.

nodes.label: Energy role colours (sage/acc/feed)
nodes.rationale: Sage family = sun, terracotta = grid. Self-consumption --sage, import --acc, feed-in --feed; ring and bars must share this grammar.

nodes.label: Cover position band
nodes.rationale: v1.8.0: reads live current_position (not SET_POSITION support), uses drag-aware pos so it tracks the finger.

nodes.label: Diagnostica settings panel
nodes.rationale: Every user-facing diagnostic has a visible counterpart here; console.log does not exist for companion-app/tablet users.

nodes.label: Demo scenario bar
nodes.rationale: Internal tool; hidden with &bare for README screenshots.

nodes.label: sc-if/sc-for templating constraints
nodes.rationale: style= property names are compile-time literal; dynamic src/href need ref callbacks; never repeat the same sc-if expression with opposite placeholders.

nodes.label: User prefs layered over config hide lists
nodes.rationale: Per-user settings-panel overrides (rooms/entities/cameras/modules/order) layer on top of config-level hide lists via discovery.resolveVisible.
nodes.norm_label: user prefs layered over config hide lists

nodes.label: dash_neumo_mobile.html (phone layout)
nodes.rationale: Mobile twin of dash_neumo.html: most methods carry 'see dash_neumo.html's copy ... kept identical' so desktop and mobile never disagree on hidden entities, energy resolution, diagnostics.

nodes.label: window.CASA_REACT_SOURCE
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: React 18.3.1 vendored in ./vendor/ and loaded via plain <script> before support.js; support.js loadReactUmd() skips its CDN fetch when React/ReactDOM exist. Flag records 'local' vs 'cdn' for Diagnostica > Ambiente. Versioned file names instead of ?v= since content never changes; missing vendor file falls back to CDN.

nodes.label: bust()
nodes.rationale: Reuses panel.js VERSION (?v=) so one bump busts the whole chain of scripts this page loads, not just the iframe.

nodes.label: loadScript()
nodes.rationale: Classic <script> injection instead of import(): Chrome blocks ES module fetches under file:// (demo mode), so discovery/i18n/backend/config expose window.Casa* globals.

nodes.label: loadUserConfig()
nodes.rationale: Tries /local/live_dashboard_config.js (outside HACS folder, survives updates), then legacy paths; /local/ paths skipped outside iframe to avoid guaranteed 404s. Captures per-path attempts for Diagnostica.

nodes.label: _startSnapTimer()
nodes.rationale: Mobile home tiles capped at 2 previews; timer paused when document hidden to save traffic.

nodes.label: _camStartStream()
nodes.rationale: v1.5.4 layered live view: WS camera stream -> native HLS -> hls.js -> fast snapshot polling; companion-app Android mostly gets the snapshot tier. reqId guards stale responses.

nodes.label: _loadHourlyEnergy()
nodes.rationale: v1.8.0 ring strip: refetches only when wall clock crosses into a new hour.

nodes.label: _resolveEnergyDaily()
nodes.rationale: Resolution order per role: config.js -> HA energy/get_prefs (mapEnergyPrefs) -> auto-discovery; lists unknown source keys so unsupported schemas self-diagnose.

nodes.label: powerVal()
nodes.rationale: Normalizes W/kW/MW to user's powerUnit pref; unrecognized units shown as-is - an honest number in a strange unit beats a wrong one (v1.5.2 hardcoded kW was 1000x off for half of inverters).

nodes.label: deriveConsumption()
nodes.rationale: v1.6.0: house consumption = production + import - export + battery term, when no consumption sensor is configured.

nodes.label: _sampleBatterySign()
nodes.rationale: Samples whether derived consumption is negative (10s throttle, 3-min window) to detect an inverted battery sign convention.

nodes.label: batterySignVerdict()
nodes.rationale: Suspect when >=5 samples and >50% negative; surfaces a settings-tab warning instead of console-only diagnostics.

nodes.label: call()
nodes.rationale: v1.8.1 no silent failures: every service call is logged in _actionLog (max 20) with outcome/timeout/ms and failures raise a visible toast - wall-tablet users have no console.

nodes.label: runValve()
nodes.rationale: Turns valve on, schedules turn_off, and persists endsAt via CasaPrefs.saveIrrigationEnds so the close survives reloads.

nodes.label: _checkIrrigationEnds()
nodes.rationale: v1.8.1 irrigation auto-close driven by persisted end-times; reads valve state as source of truth; _irrigationClosing Set prevents double turn_off from close 15s ticks.

nodes.label: _bindAttr()
nodes.rationale: Ref-callback attribute setter: dynamic src/href/points must be set after mount, not via template hole (parser loads them before JS runs).

nodes.label: _panelLpDown()
nodes.rationale: Long-press to hide entity; a >10px drag cancels it. Covers deliberately lack data-entity-id so slider drags never open the hide menu.

nodes.label: SECTION_ORDER()
nodes.rationale: v1.7.0 Casa home section order: saved prefs merged over config order over discovery default; mobile Casa tab is a single stack.

nodes.label: _settingsProblemTab()
nodes.rationale: Opens settings directly on the tab that has a problem (energia/diagnostica); cannot reuse renderVals rows because they're built later in the same render.

nodes.label: diagEnvironment()
nodes.rationale: Diagnostica > Ambiente rows: version, backend, iframe, lang, React source (local/cdn), registry counts, prefs outcome.

nodes.label: renderVals()
nodes.rationale: Builds the entire template value bag: tabs, Casa sections, rooms/pills, cameras, energy rings + hourly strip + bars, irrigation zones, vehicle, settings and diagnostics. Exposes noDiagActionRows as its own name rather than negating hasDiagActionRows in a second sc-if (CLAUDE.md constraint 6).

nodes.label: state.hourlyEnergy / hourlyBars ring strip
nodes.rationale: Stacked hourly bars: auto (sage), grid (acc), feed (feed) - same color grammar as the ring. Uses toFixed not this.dec() because it-IT decimal comma would break the CSS percentage in a style= hole.

nodes.label: noDiagActionRows template value
nodes.rationale: Empty-state branch of Ultime azioni exposed under its own name; two sc-if on the same expression with opposite hint-placeholder-val rendered both branches (v1.8.1 bug).

nodes.label: Energy double ring (outer self/grid, inner self/feed)
nodes.rationale: Outer ring: autoconsumo vs prelievo over consumoCasa; inner ring: self vs immissione over production. Roles colored --sage/--acc/--feed per CLAUDE.md.
nodes.norm_label: energy double ring (outer self/grid, inner self/feed)

nodes.label: Diagnostica settings panel
nodes.rationale: User-facing counterpart of every console diagnostic: config attempts, energy instant/daily, recent actions, irrigation, environment, camera layers, ring/hourly, alarm, entity discard reasons, duplicate devices (HA 2026.9 Matter).
